dedupe_keys.name: structural demand consequences of liquefaction and its mitigation with dense granular columns using machine learning

description: Caroline Bessette, Abbie Liel and Shideh Dashti published a database of structural and foundation response to soil liquefaction through DesignSafe. It covers approximately 4,000 three-dimensional, nonlinear, coupled effective-stress finite-element analyses. The source reports centrifuge validation and quasi-Monte Carlo sampling. Outputs include peak story drift and roof acceleration, with foundation acceleration as an additional response measure. Simulations compare untreated deposits with dense granular columns beneath the centre and perimeter of the foundation. These results support structural-response prediction and assessment of liquefaction mitigation. The metadata do not specify a geographic calibration area, complete file formats or sampling intervals. Public access is through the repository at no stated charge under Creative Commons Attribution, with the licence version unspecified. Dataset contents and reported validation were not independently tested. The related DesignSafe Data Depot record describes the repository.
